entities.summary: The Ethnographic Museum, formerly the National Museum of Rwanda, is a national museum in Rwanda. It is located in Butare. It is owned by Institute of National Museums of Rwanda. Ethnographic Museum is a museum in Africa, established in 1989-09-18. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
